name: Billinghurst Cave
level: Experienced (Advanced Open Water and deep experience)
description: Large cave west of Reqqa Point. The entrance is at about 28 m and rises to about 14 m inside. Two big chambers reach about 150 m into the rock; the inner one has an air pocket, but the air is not breathable. Take plenty of air.
conditions: Only in flat calm conditions; sharp rocks at the entry.
